zh-CN.title: 老子（李耳）
zh-CN.subtitle: 道家经典传统的源头人物与后世神圣化对象
zh-CN.shortSummary: 老子是进入道家经典传统的高识别度入口，但李耳传记、〈老子〉身份、《道德经》成书与后世太上老君形象必须分层处理。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把‘李耳’作为史传中的人物名字，把‘老子’作为思想与师承传统中的称谓，把《道德经》的作者/编纂问题另行建模。
老子可以连接先秦源头、唐代道教接受和后世神格化，但不能因为知名度高就把所有道家文本都变成一个人的直接言论。
zh-CN.researchNote: 生平年代与历史性存在争议；《史记》提供早期史传层，具体文本归属、出关叙事和太上老君神格化应分别连接来源。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 传统置于春秋晚期；生平年代有争议

en.title: Laozi (Li Er)
en.subtitle: A source figure of Daoist classicism and a later object of sacralisation
en.shortSummary: Laozi is a recognisable gateway into Daoist classicism, but the Li Er biography, the sage-name Laozi, the formation of the Daodejing and the later Taishang Laojun image must remain distinct layers.
curatorialDescription: The museum treats Li Er as a name in early historiographical tradition, Laozi as a figure in intellectual and lineage traditions, and the authorship and formation of the Daodejing as a separate modelled question.
Laozi can connect an early source horizon with Tang reception and later sacralisation, but fame must not turn every Daoist text into a direct utterance by one person.
en.researchNote: Life dates and historicity are contested. The Shiji provides an early historiographical layer; textual attribution, the departure through Hangu Pass and later Taishang Laojun sacralisation require separate relations and sources.
en.timeLabel: Traditionally placed in the late Spring and Autumn period; dates contested
